title: FlexLine Workout Relief: Delinquency Depth Share
content:
For FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit workout relief, the depth share follows the days the line is past due on the relief date: 30 days or more give 0.50; 15 to 29 days give 0.75; fewer days give 1.00.

The share multiplies the workout relief as figured from the fee, before it is rounded to the cent. Days past due are the calendar days from the line's next due date to the relief date while an amount is past due.

| Days past due on the relief date | Share |
|---|---|
| 30 or more | 0.50 |
| 15 to 29 | 0.75 |
| fewer than 15 | 1.00 |

*Hypothetical points:* with a next due date of 1 June, relief granted on 15 June is 14 days past due (1.00), on 16 June 15 days (0.75), on 1 July 30 days (0.50). A 25.00 USD relief at 0.75 is 18.75 USD before rounding.
